defensiveAbilities.name: Spewing Bile
defensiveAbilities.description:
When the penanggalan takes slashing damage, their wound spews bile on adjacent creatures, dealing 2d10 Poison Damage damage (Basic DC 19 Fortitude Saving Throw save).

The penanggalan loses their spewing bile and penanggalan bile abilities until the end of their next turn.

offensiveAbilities.name: Constrict
offensiveAbilities.description:
(2d4+3) Bludgeoning Damage, Basic DC 21 Fortitude Saving Throw

See rules...

The monster deals the listed amount of damage to any number of creatures Grabbed or Restrained by it. Each of those creatures can attempt a basic Fortitude save with the listed DC.

offensiveAbilities.name: Elongate Tongue
offensiveAbilities.description: The penanggalan's tongue extends, the membrane stretching and becoming translucent. Until the end of the turn, the penanggalan's proboscis tongue Strikes have a 10-foot reach, and any target is Off-Guard against the Strike unless it has a Perception DC of 22 or higher or the ability to precisely sense Invisible things.

offensiveAbilities.name: Penanggalan Bile
offensiveAbilities.description:
Rest doesn't decrease the drained value from penanggalan bile

Saving Throw DC 19 Fortitude Saving Throw

Stage 1 Drained 1 (1 week)

Stage 2 Drained 2 (1 week)

Stage 3 Drained 3 (1 week)

Stage 4 dead

offensiveAbilities.name: Ride Corpse
offensiveAbilities.description:
The penanggalan inserts their entrails into their humanoid body, allowing them to appear as and move about like a normal human. The body has 10 Hit Points and the same defenses as the penanggalan.

When the body is destroyed, the penanggalan is ejected unharmed. The body becomes a corpse, and if it is neither controlled by the penanggalan nor stored in an alchemical vat, it decays as normal.
